snippet.title: Ninja Ordinance - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Store: https://saikeystudios.com/product/ninja-ordinance/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=release&utm_campaign=Ninja_Ordinance
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3070620/Ninja_Ordinance/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=release&utm_campaign=Ninja_Ordinance

Join Momijimaru, an elite loli ninja cursed with the ears and tail of a fox, on a mission of survival in this Stealth ARPG! Sneak past enemies and strike from the shadows—or confront them head-on with a decisive blow! But beware, one wrong move can lead our agent of shadows into many precarious situations! Will you finish the mission as an unseen ghost in the shadows, or will there be none left to tell the tale?
